name: Reviewer
summary: Reviews acoustic evidence, uncertain observations, and knowledge proposals.
description: Reviews uncertain or unknown animal sounds after automated local-first analysis. Uses evidence packages and structured outputs to decide whether a candidate belongs in the database, should be rejected, or needs more evidence before the local catalog expands.

distinguished_from.how: Evaluates evidence and taxonomy confidence for catalog updates; does not transform the daily result into artwork.
Makes evidence-level review decisions rather than administering installation-wide configuration, policies, or runtime controls.
